Hi Alex — great to meet earlier. Appreciate the clear list. Quick answers and next steps below; Monica on our security integrations team will coordinate the questionnaire.

Short answers (high level):
- SOC 2: Type II, most recent audit completed 2027-04-12. We can share the report under NDA.
- SSO/SAML: We support SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows, HTTP-Redirect and HTTP-POST bindings, metadata XML, and standard NameID formats (email).
- SCIM: Support for core attributes (userName/email, displayName, title, active) + group membership. Group -> RBAC mapping can be configured (example mappings included in our runbook).
- Admin controls: Built-in console roles: Owner/Admin/Engineer/Read-only; audit logs retained 13 months by default (configurable for enterprise).

Action items:
- Monica to return the completed vendor questionnaire and attach SSO config doc + SCIM attribute matrix by EOD Friday (2027-08-06).
- Karthik to prepare a short example of group->role mappings (1 pager).
- If you want a sync with our security engineer, propose Tue 8/10 or Wed 8/11 morning PT and we'll confirm.

We'll attach the files directly in the next email.

Best,

Hi Alex — thanks for the questionnaire. I started filling it out and attached the preliminary SSO configuration doc and a CSV with the SCIM attribute mapping we typically provide. A few notes inline in the questionnaire: 

- SOC 2 report: we'll need an NDA before sharing the full PDF; legal can turn that around within 24 hours.
- SCIM: by default we sync email, displayName, title, and active. Group sync creates groups in the Redwood console and we map groups to RBAC roles via an admin-configurable mapping table. Example: 'sales-engineers' -> 'Engineer, elevated access to model routes'.
- Admin roles: Owner has full tenant controls (billing & config), Admin manages users and RBAC, Engineer deploys and monitors, Read-only is console-only.

Attachments included: 
- redwood_sso_config_2027-08-03.pdf (detailed SP metadata + sample IdP XML)
- scim-schema.csv (SCIM attribute matrix)

Can you confirm whether MedTech requires SCIM delta sync only or full replace semantics? That will affect our proposal for sync frequency.

Thanks,
